open_points.subject: A01 rule 5 request-check precedence
open_points.text: “after the checks every request passes (A16 rule 1: size, token, depth, schema, actor)” does not distinguish the request message’s depth check from the later depth check for JSON texts carried inside request strings; A16 places those carried-text checks within schema validation.
open_points.question: When a request both fails its operation schema and contains an over-depth JSON text in a string field, which failure takes precedence?
options: “depth” means only the outer request-message depth; the schema failure precedes validation of carried JSON texts
All depth checks, including carried JSON texts, precede every schema check
open_points.default_guess: Treat “depth” as the outer request-message depth only and follow A16’s detailed order, so the schema failure precedes the carried JSON text’s depth failure.
